Subject: Quick recap + proposed success criteria (POV)

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned before we draft the trial plan:

- Primary use case: triage-assist for the nurse intake queue (free-text patient notes -> structured triage suggestions).
- Key success metrics you mentioned: 1) 30% reduction in average triage time for intake notes, 2) 95% precision on high-priority flagging (safety-critical), 3) integration with Epic sandbox and response under 500ms median.
- Timeline target: 4-week POV starting ~Jul 6, with final readout in week 5.

Owners (proposed):
- Redwood: Rachel (AE) — overall coordination; Ben (Solutions) — infra + integration support; Marissa (CS) — onboarding and eval design.
- Veridian: Sanjay — clinical owner; Laura — engineering/IT lead.

Next steps I suggest:
1) I’ll share a one-page POV plan (success criteria + test prompts + acceptance rubric) by Friday.
2) Laura, could you confirm access to Epic sandbox and point-of-contact for the integration work?
3) Sanjay, are there specific sample notes or a small prompt set you want us to prioritize?

I’ve attached a starter spreadsheet (veridian-poc-success-criteria.xlsx) with the acceptance rubric and a placeholder evaluation schedule. Also sharing a recording of today’s demo for internal review.

If that all looks right I’ll convert the sheet into a mutual action plan and send over a scheduling poll for the kickoff.

Thanks —
Rachel

Subject: Re: Quick recap + proposed success criteria (POV)

Thanks Rachel — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- The 30% triage time reduction is an aspirational target; baseline is ~4.5 minutes per triage. If we can hit 20% that would still be a win.
- Safety is non-negotiable; the 95% precision should be for high-priority flags (~top 3% of cases). We need false negatives to be <1% for that category.
- Epic sandbox: Laura can confirm access later today. Note: our sandbox requires a static IP allowlist for API calls. Can Redwood accommodate that?

Sample data: I’ll pull ~200 de-identified triage notes and share a secure link by end of day Thursday.

One ask on evaluation: can Redwood produce per-run latency histograms (p50/p90/p99) and token-cost estimates for the POV so we can include them in the internal approval?

—Sanjay
Sanjay Patel
Director, Clinical Operations | Veridian Health
sanjay@veridianhealth.com
